lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Al2Ag6 (reduced formula Ba4AlAg3) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 10 geometric neighbors (4 Ag, 2 Al, 4 Ba), Al centers with 14 neighbors (4 Ag, 6 Ba, 4 Al), and Ba centers with 12 neighbors (4 Ag, 8 Ba). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between Ag and Ba polyhedra, edge sharing between Ag and Ba polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ba polyhedra.
